::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Delhi-based imaging startup developing CMOS sensor platforms for medical diagnostics and life sciences, including SWIR (900–1700 nm) cameras. Raised funding under the National Quantum Mission through IIT Bombay's Qmet Tech Foundation.
:::

## What does this firm design?

CMOS image-sensor platforms and SWIR cameras for medical and industrial imaging.
